push.title: L 1-3 vs Amala Boys | You: 7.8
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.8. I've seen you do better, which is exactly why I'm not worried.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Amala Boys's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ 11th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ Passes attempted 40, up from your usual 34. You earned that one the honest way.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 1. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ 3 goals conceded delivered +0.1. Keep it up.

THE BAD
- 72% passing (29 of 40). Start here: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only. You've got this.
- Match 5 of the session and your rating had slid from 8.8 early on to 7.8. Note to self, from me to you.
- Goal involvements 1, down from your usual 3. Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- In our wins you average 2 key passes; here it was 0. Here's how: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
- 2 tackles won cost 0.1. One thing at a time.

Homework: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: Believe in yourself the way your dog believes in you.

Every game teaches us something. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 60% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: Goals per shot on target: 0% (bottom quarter of forwards is 30% or less)
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

weaknesses.detail: 23/35 passes (66%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.1. Every oak was an acorn that got rained on. Let's grow.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Amala Boys's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ On-ball actions 45, up from your usual 34. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ 3 goals conceded pushed +0.1. Underrated work.
+ Best tackles attempted of your 5 matches this session (5). That's the stuff I want framed.

THE BAD
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Simple fix: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Clean it up and fly.
- 66% passing (23 of 35, down from your usual 77%). From the clipboard: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Easy as pie.
- 2 tackles won: -0.1. Leaky faucet stuff. Small drips, big bill.
- Key passes: 0. Solid ground. The best forwards push it to 2+.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 2. A team result, and it needs a team answer.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 7.1, down from your usual 8.6. We owe the team better than that. All of us.

Backyard drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

BellyTb1, from me to you: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

Good effort, better days ahead. - Coach Lasso
